verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo states Firecrawl is open source under the AGPL-3.0 license, and a community member confirms the AGPL terms allow forking the code. One caveat: the cloud version includes additional features that are evidently not part of the open repo. Missing for 10: source for cloud-only features, which is not shown to be under the open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Firecrawl is open source under the AGPL-3.0 license.
Open source and available as a hosted service
AGPL means you can just fork and remove everything you don't like (including branding).
